name: Japanese Horror Game Protagonist
summary: Japanese Horror Game Protagonist is a fashion aesthetic and TikTok microtrend that emerged in 2023, which consists of outfits inspired by the female protagonists in popular Japanese horror games, most notably the Fatal Frame series.
description: Japanese Horror Game Protagonist is a fashion aesthetic and TikTok microtrend that emerged in 2023, which consists of outfits inspired by the female protagonists in popular Japanese horror games, most notably the Fatal Frame series. The aesthetic is related to and largely reliant on Coquette fashion, specifically the Dark Nymphet subtype, with added 2000s-era Japanese influences. It is characterized by dark-colored, hyper-feminine pieces, layered with accessories to evoke the appearance of heroines from Japanese horror media.

fashion.Tops: As this aesthetic is based on Japanese horror media, specifically video games, the fashion intentionally tries to emulate the style portrayed within those games. The tops common to that niche type of media include babydoll, empire-waist, and Milkmaid tops, and tops with puff, flutter, and frill sleeves. They often have lace trims around the neck and hem, ruffles, ribbons, and scoop, square or sweetheart necklines. Peter Pan collars are typical, as are puritan and sailor collars. From the…
fashion.Bottoms: Japanese Horror Game Protagonist fashion contains multiple references to schoolgirl fashion, as the protagonists are often of that age. Specifically, pleated miniskirts, solid or plaid, are very popular and easy to find in comparison to many of the pieces from Japan. The short length also contributes to the hyper-feminine, sometimes sexy, look that is common in Coquette fashion. fashion.Accessories and Shoes: Socks and tights are common here, often used to emphasize long legs and add a bit of coverage beneath short skirts. Knee- and thigh-high socks are typical to this trend, as are opaque stockings, leg warmers and boot socks. Jewelry is important to this aesthetic, too -- chokers are a very popular choice, especially plain black ones or ones with a single dangling pendant, as are necklaces, also with pendants (typically Gothic crosses, hearts, or skeleton keys).
